title: Complaint handling
description: District Commission handling of a complaint related to goods

steps.step: Refer a copy of the admitted complaint to the opposite party within 21 days of admission, directing them to respond within 30 days or an extended period not exceeding 15 days
If the opposite party denies or disputes the allegations, proceed to settle the consumer dispute
If the complaint alleges a defect in goods, obtain a sample from the complainant, seal and authenticate it, and refer it to an appropriate laboratory for analysis or test
Require the complainant to deposit fees for payment to the laboratory before referring the sample for analysis or test
Remit the deposited amount to the laboratory and forward a copy of the report to the opposite party
If a party disputes the laboratory findings, require them to submit written objections
Give a reasonable opportunity to both parties to be heard regarding the report and objections, and issue an appropriate order under section 39
